verdicts.reason: A keeps the headline readable inside the dark panel, but the panel nearly fills the canvas width. The patterned brush strokes, which define the brand, shrink to thin slivers around it, and large blank white bands sit above and below, so it looks like a shrunk strip rather than a real redesign. B is unusable: the dark panel is empty, and the headline has moved into a tiny white box above it where it is unreadable (only a few pixels high). The panel also covers most of the pattern.
